This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1 for step up and step down oil 
power power transformer, which must be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Abd El-Halim El-Nagar, tested by eng. Ayman 
El-Sherbiny, reviewed by eng. Mohamed Salah El-din Badawy, revised by quality control eng. Adel 
Abd el Qader El nagar at 
step up and step down, 
accepted by general director eng. Ahmed El hosiny and approved by eng. Mohamed 
El Sarag damietta P.S head sector

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control's head sector

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, and harness ....
Transformer isolation and earthing on all its sides is required

There is danger of falling into the oil containment pit when working 
 near large power transformer

A proper well fixed ladder should be used for climbing on tap of the 
 transformer tank

Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1 for step up and step down oil 
power power transformer, which must be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Abd El-Halim El-Nagar, tested by eng. Ayman 
El-Sherbiny, reviewed by eng. Mohamed Salah El-din Badawy, revised by quality control eng. Adel 
Abd el Qader El nagar at 
step up and step down, 
accepted by general director eng. Ahmed El hosiny and approved by eng. Mohamed 
El Sarag damietta P.S head sector
This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control's head sector
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, and harness ....
Transformer isolation and earthing on all its sides is required
There is danger of falling into the oil containment pit when working 
 near large power transformer
A proper well fixed ladder should be used for climbing on tap of the 
 transformer tank

sections_ar.text: توضح هذه الوثيقة إجراءات الصيانة P1 لمحول القدرة الزيتي الرافع والخافض، التي يجب تنفيذها كل خمس سنوات كما هو موضح بـ Y5 في خانة العنوان أعلاه

أعدّ المسودة الأولى م. Ahmed Abd El-Halim El-Nagar، واختبرها م. Ayman El-Sherbiny، وراجعها م. Mohamed Salah El-din Badawy، وراجعها م. Adel Abd el Qader El nagar مهندس مراقبة الجودة في قسم الرافع والخافض، وقبلها م. Ahmed El hosiny المدير العام، واعتمدها م. Mohamed El Sarag رئيس قطاع محطة Damietta P.S

قبل هذه الوثيقة م. Samir Abd El Gilil منسق MPIS بشركة EDEPC، وصدّق عليها المحاسب Mahmoud Soliman المدير العام للتفتيش الإداري والمالي ومراقبة الجودة بشركة EDEPC والمشرف على قطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة
يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة
